consular.mission: Australian Consulate, Riga; Australian Embassy, Stockholm
consular.notes: Australia has a Consulate in Latvia headed by an Honorary Consul. The Consulate provides limited consular assistance. It doesn't provide visa and immigration services or passports. For full consular services, contact the Australian Embassy in Stockholm, Sweden.
